title: Earthquake, Vanuatu, 17 December 2024 (EQ20241217VUT)
description:
UNOSAT geodata for Earthquake, Vanuatu, 17 December 2024 (EQ20241217VUT), from 2 datasets on the Humanitarian Data Exchange. HDX describes the event:

**UNOSAT code: EQ20241217VUT, GDACS ID: 1458084**  This map illustrates the potentially damaged structures/buildings and landslide extents resulting from the earthquake on December 17, 2024, in Vanuatu, as detected from a WorldView-2 very high-resolution satellite image acquired on December 20, 2024, at 09:46 local time. Within the analyzed area of approximately 3,000 hectares, UNOSAT identified 6 potentially damaged structures and 20 hectares of land affected by landslides.
This is a preliminary analysis and has not yet been validated in the field. Please send ground feedback to United Nations Satellite Centre (UNOSAT).

HDX datasets:

- [Damage Assessment in Malorua District, Shefa Province, Vanuatu as of 20 December 2024](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/damage-assessment-in-malorua-district-shefa-province-vanuatu-as-of-20-december-2024)
- [UNOSAT Live Web Map -M 7.3 Earthquake - Port-Vila, Vanuatu](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/unosat-live-web-map-m-7-3-earthquake-port-vila-vanuatu)
